name: standards-mcp
title: Standards MCP — Global Compliance & Dual-Use Export Gateway
description: Deterministic Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for international technical standards, mandatory product certifications (CCC, CE, UL), and dual-use export control regimes. Currently serving China (GB/T, CNCA, MOFCOM) with cross-jurisdictional equivalence engines.

tools.name: resolve_gb_standards
tools.description: Resolves applicable Chinese national standards (GB mandatory, GB/T recommended) and verifies China Compulsory Certification (CCC) requirements under SAMR/CNCA.

tools.name: check_mofcom_export_controls
tools.description: Checks Chinese Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) export control regimes, dual-use licensing, and bilateral truce suspensions for minerals, batteries, and tech.

tools.name: assess_importability
tools.description: Evaluates end-to-end importability of Chinese industrial components into the EU or US, assessing mandatory export approvals, overseas documentation, costs and lead times.
